note: First my-uob offers recipe, written 20 Nov 2026 from plain saved listing pages. Each category and location listing server-renders at most six tiles (data-max=6). The Load more control posts to /revamp/personal/ajax-category-page-filter.page, and robots.txt Disallow: /revamp/* blocks that path, so this recipe stays in plain mode and does not use actions.expand_selector. Query filters such as dining-deals.page?filter=asian also render the same unfiltered first six tiles. other-deals.page is complete at three of data-total=3; the Avis Car Rental tile has no dedicated .page link (terms PDF on the tile). A merchant that appears on more than one listing is one offer. Featured pages japanese-cuisine.page and tinkermen-collective.page are linked from the promotions index and are read by hand, not as tiles on these listings.
